class.name: MultiplayerProfiler
class.brief_description: What a [SceneMultiplayer] sends and receives, for the project to read while it runs.
class.description:
Counts the packets and bytes a [SceneMultiplayer] sends and receives, and for each node its RPCs and its [MultiplayerSynchronizer] updates, so the project can show or log its network use itself, in exported builds too. Unlike the editor's network profiler, it needs no debugger. Each [SceneMultiplayer] has one, as [member SceneMultiplayer.profiler]: [codeblocks] [gdscript] func _ready(): multiplayer.profiler.enabled = true
func _on_stats_timer_timeout(): var data = multiplayer.profiler.get_data() $Stats.text = "In: %d B/s Out: %d B/s" % [data.bytes_in, data.bytes_out] [/gdscript] [/codeblocks] It is off until [member enabled] is set; while off, what it would count costs a single check, so it can stay in release builds and be switched on only when wanted.

method.name: get_data
method.description: Returns what was counted: for the last whole second, [code]packets_in[/code], [code]bytes_in[/code], [code]packets_out[/code] and [code]bytes_out[/code]; since [member enabled] was set (or [method reset] was called), the same with [code]total_[/code] in front ([code]total_bytes_in[/code], ...); and [code]nodes[/code], an [Array] with a [Dictionary] for each node that sent or received anything, holding [code]node[/code] (its [NodePath], empty once it has left the tree), [code]name[/code], and for each of [code]rpc_in[/code], [code]rpc_out[/code], [code]sync_in[/code], [code]sync_out[/code], [code]delta_in[/code] and [code]delta_out[/code], the count and [code]_bytes[/code] for the last second and the same with [code]total_[/code] in front. Byte counts are those of the packets as sent, headers of the [MultiplayerPeer] itself not included. Freed nodes with nothing left to report are dropped.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], traffic is counted. Switching it on starts from nothing.
